body: Peer-to-peer B2B. 30-second sales cycle. Emergency spot rate $0.20 when a truck runs dry mid-event. Eastern Market, Oakland County rallies, Detroit festivals. Emily shows up, gives bags of tortillas, doesn't pitch. Goal: every taco truck in Detroit metro has STINKIES' number.
title: S155-02: truck-to-truck Tier 0 — 10 trucks with our number, $0.15-0.20/tortilla spot+weekly, $23-31K/yr
